authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2574 ka explicitly gives eastern ke “who”, Palula ko and Khowar ka, with what/why ka in the Western Pahari addendum. Survey what/where forms need to be separated from local kim-derived or adverbial constructions; the who forms are the immediate supported subset. The comparative family link retains uncertainty about transfer between Indo-Aryan languages. Comparative check: bundeli_atarra ko “who” (f_wq23l7qpzah4k). The exact survey spelling and semantic marks remain untouched. Equivalent elicitation glosses and ordinary inflections were reviewed together; source person, number, honorific and tense labels remain in the original record. The full form and sense support this same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.
